describe.description: The creature is a large quadrupedal mammal shown in right-facing profile against a plain off-white background, with the overall body shape, fur, and proportions of a brown bear. It is covered in dense, shaggy brown fur that is darker on the back and legs and lighter cream-white on the underbelly, chest and throat. Four sturdy, fur-covered legs support the body and end in broad clawed paws. Fused into the fur across the back, sides, neck, throat and leg joints are multiple glossy, dark reddish-brown to black chitinous plates resembling a beetle's exoskeleton, including a large curved horn on the forehead, a shield-like plate over the shoulders, and large ridged wing-cover plates on the flanks. A short furry tail is visible at the rear and the head is bear-like with a dark muzzle and nose.
